description: Update a Thalovant runtime group's name, description, or spec. spec patches replicas and container resources. This route does NOT use If-Match, so no etag is required. Requires the hubs:write scope and a paid plan.

apiUrl.description: Control-plane base URL. Configured credentials may only be used on their configured origin; defaults to https://api.thalovant.com.

loginScope.description: Optional login scope used with THALOVANT_EMAIL and THALOVANT_PASSWORD.

spec.description: Patches replicas and container resources only. Note the replica ceiling here is 20, separate from a hub's autoscaling ceiling of 32.

resources.description: Container resource requests/limits, as string-valued maps (for example {"cpu": "500m"}).

name: thalovant_update_runtime_group
title: Update Runtime Group
